results.original_title: O Testamento: O Segredo de Anita Harley
results.overview: Anita Harley is the main shareholder of Casas Pernambucanas, one of the most traditional retail chains in Brazil. This miniseries reveals the behind-the-scenes disputes surrounding her inheritance in one of the most complex and intriguing cases in the Brazilian judiciary.

results.title: The Saddest Man in The World
results.overview: A little joyful girl, Emili, happens upon a peculiar circus after a good deed. Their main act is dubbed “The Saddest Man in The World”. After entering it to see the act in person the real and unreal mix in a way that makes them impossible to distinguish in her innocent eyes.

results.title: Quién Llorará Por Mí
results.overview: The greatest fear a mother of a son with disabilities holds is the future: the uncertainty of what will happen to her son once she is gone.

results.title: The Parking Spot
results.overview: A quarrel over a parking space pulls a couple into an unexpected confrontation with a stranger.

results.title: Not to Kill
results.overview: A critical memoir about revolutionary violence in Argentina in the 1970s.

results.title: A Year of School
results.overview: 2007. Fred, a 17-year-old girl who just moved from Sweden to Northeast Italy, enrolls for her high school senior year—finding herself the only female student in an all-male class. Lively and good-looking, she quickly becomes the center of attention, especially for three classmates: Antero, charming and reserved; Pasini, a cocky womanizer; Mitis, gruff and sagacious. The three have been best friends for as long as they can remember, but Fred's arrival puts their longstanding bond to the test. As each of the guys secretly desires Fred for himself, she yearns to be accepted into the group and be considered 'one of them', but is asked to sacrifice more and more in order to belong.

results.title: To the Woods
results.overview: A summer night, in a red house with blue shutters bordered by the forest. We hear the river flowing from the room where Sister, four years old, wakes Brother, ten years old. Because she has decided: tonight they will go swimming. Through the open window, the two children slip into the darkness. They slip between flowers, brambles, trees... And finally it is the water, the reflection of the stars, their two bodies at rest. But in the distance the storm is rumbling. It is already necessary to return. Brother and Sister go hand in hand. Suddenly, Brother disappears. Sister chases him, runs out of breath, spins around, despairs. Is it a game of hide-and-seek? A trick of the forest? Or is it her memory which, years later, plays a cruel trick on her ?

results.title: The Go-Between
results.overview: After school, nine-year-old Almir meets a stranger whose seemingly harmless request draws him into a world of unspoken violence.

results.title: Clover
results.overview: A student news crew follows a week in the life of Frankie Bernard, the unluckiest teen in the world, after she finds a four-leafed clover that changes her luck as long as she holds onto it... or does it?

results.title: Terra-Mãe
results.overview: In a world where men have never existed,women leave the city when it is time to give birth. Zeza and Olivia arrive at Celeste's house,a midwife and keeper of an ancient secret. Zeza's body carries, however, somethingthat should not exist: a male child. Celeste knows the signs. For generations, midwives have kept this secret within the earth, passed down through prayers and rituals known to no one else. As the birth draws near, Celeste prepares to fulfil what has been entrusted to her.

results.title: The Ivy
results.overview: Azucena, a woman in her thirties, approaches Julio, a teenage boy living in a group home, for reasons he doesn’t understand. As they spend time together, an uneasy closeness grows, changing the shape of a bond neither expected to find.

results.title: Dirty Games
results.overview: Four crime stories follow desperate people crossing dangerous lines for money, truth, power and survival, where every choice has consequences and nobody gets out clean.

results.title: Learning to Breathe Under Water
results.overview: Leo is 8. His best friend is a giant shark that his dad, an artist, built in their roof. Leo escapes to fantasy worlds to process his peculiar reality until a spirited au pair challenges him to embrace the wild, wonderful mess of real life.

results.title: Invictus
results.overview: In both work and life, Liu Hao had always been the one looked down upon. That is, until he met Cai Cai—two young souls who fell deeply in love. Just as they were brimming with confidence, ready to embark on a bright future, a sudden accident overturned their lives completely. Faced with a cruel world and a humiliating existence, they chose divergent paths of resistance...

results.title: Red Light Teachers
results.overview: A desperate immigrant forced into the world of underground strip clubs crosses paths with a disillusioned drama teacher, both rediscover the meaning of dignity, art, and second chances.

results.title: Muppet Treasure Scriptland
results.overview: The Muppet Script returns to bring you MUPPET TREASURE SCRIPTLAND! When most people think of the Muppets, they think of the colorful characters made out of fleece and foam. But as with every movie, it all starts on the written page. And before returning to the big screen, the Muppets team returned to the writers' room. Another literary classic was turned on its head when Muppets scribe JERRY JUHL skewered ROBERT LOUIS STEVENSON'S tale of nautical adventure, joined this time by KIRK THATCHER and JAMES V. HART, and directed once again by JIM HENSON'S son, BRIAN HENSON. This performance will be a treasure worth its weight in gold!

results.title: Tchaikovsky: Piano Concerto No. 1 - Bruce Liu in Lisbon
results.original_title: Tchaikovsky: Piano Concerto No. 1 Bruce Liu in Lisbon
results.overview: Europiano continues from Lisbon's beautiful Torre de Belém, a symbol of the city on the waterfront.Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 in B flat minor is performed by Bruce Liu with the Orquestra Gulbenkian conducted by Hannu Lintu.

results.title: HIM+
results.overview: Chris is a young Black man whose life takes a drastic turn when he learns he is HIV positive. Struggling with fear, stigma, and uncertainty, Chris is forced to confront himself and the world around him in a new way. Through the support of his faith, friends, and mentor, he begins to discover strength and resilience he didn’t know he had.
